blocks.text: This dossier exists so ten (here, three) lane detectives share one starting picture instead of ten independently reconstructed ones. Read the block diagram before your own lane's deep-dive.

blocks.body: (1) cron's durability assumption is violated at two consumer boundaries. (2) channel delivery is 'stored' vs 'received' are conflated by every caller sampled so far.

blocks.label: Transport-irrelevance axiom — system-level verdict
blocks.text: Holds for channel; violated for cron, where in-memory transport IS session lifetime, and every consumer that forgets this gets it wrong the same way.

  cron[cron] -->|job presence read as proof| gate[loop-gate]

blocks.caption: The dashed edge is the seam risk itself, not a real call — both consumers make the same wrong assumption independently.

blocks.text: Open questions handed to the strategist: should durability live outside the session table for cron? Should 'delivered' be renamed to reduce the conflation risk at the channel/handoff seam?
